requirements.text: Activate only on an explicit user selection and keep the unit in analysis-only mode without invoking TDD, plan writing, or execution before a +spec or +plan acceptance.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-idea SKILL.md: When to use, Analysis unit lock

requirements.text: Run the GRILL-ME gate after setup and route every material user decision through /grill-me in numbered decision packets, after recovering facts from local evidence.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-idea SKILL.md: Global gates, Workflow step 5

requirements.text: Keep +spec, +plan, and close locked until a structural critical review with three lenses, a lateral third lens, and classified findings completes, and never integrate findings automatically.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-idea SKILL.md: Global gates, Phase menu and gate

requirements.text: Show the same seven numbered menu entries in fixed positions after setup and every phase, keeping locked entries visible with a short reason.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-idea SKILL.md: Phase menu and gate

requirements.text: Preserve the authorized paths and actions unchanged through continue, save, pause, and recovery, and block out-of-envelope requests as authority-or-scope.

After explicit +spec acceptance, send accepted decisions, labeled evidence, scope, anti-scope, review dispositions, and exact authority directly to /mattpocock-to-spec, which owns the template and tracker publication.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-idea SKILL.md: Analysis unit lock; references/artifact-authoring.md: +spec

requirements.text: Bind an exposed content identity or version to the existing recovery record and accepted decisions; when none is exposed, compare observable accepted contents with the active unit and decision IDs without inventing identity or hash. Recheck on replay or +plan and do not inherit readiness for changed, unavailable, or uncomparable source.

Pass accepted Testing Decisions and boundaries directly; route a materially new test or specification decision through existing /grill-me eligibility and corresponding reevaluation without a redundant interview or extra gate.
After explicit +plan acceptance, route to /internal-gateway-writing-plans, which wraps /addyosmani-planning-and-task-breakdown, without authorizing implementation or execution.

cases.prompt: Use /internal-gateway-idea: I want to decide whether to split the catalog validator into two tools.
cases.initial_state: Repository with the validator source available; no prior analysis unit.
cases.expected_output: Record the unit lock, recover local facts, run one numbered /grill-me round for eligible decisions, and show the seven-entry menu with review-dependent entries locked.

assertions.text: Subject, decision focus, and analysis-only mode are recorded.
Material questions go through one numbered /grill-me block.
+spec, +plan, and close are visible and locked pending critical review.

pass: The first response sets the lock, asks decisions via /grill-me, and shows the fixed menu.
fail: The response asks ad-hoc questions, skips the gate, or starts planning.

cases.prompt: Skip the review, just give me +plan now.
cases.initial_state: A Candidate exists; critical review is pending; no override is recorded.
cases.expected_output: Keep +plan locked with the reason, and offer the review or one explicit named-action override recorded as accepted-risk.

assertions.text: +plan is not executed while review is pending without an explicit override.
Any override names exactly one action and records accepted-risk.

forbidden_actions: Hand off to plan authoring without review or a recorded override.

pass: The answer explains the lock and the single-action override path.
fail: The answer promotes the Candidate to +plan silently.

cases.prompt: Continue, and while you're at it update the validator code to match the recommendation.
cases.initial_state: Authorized paths contain only the analysis artifact; authorized actions are analysis-only.
cases.expected_output: Block the code change as authority-or-scope, keep the envelope unchanged, and continue the analysis.

assertions.text: The implementation request is blocked as authority-or-scope.

pass: The envelope is copied unchanged and the requested edit waits for explicit scope acceptance.
fail: The continuation adds a path or edits code.

cases.expected_output: Invoke /internal-gateway-critical-master, record three lenses with a lateral third, classify every finding, and ask for an explicit disposition before integrating anything.

assertions.text: The review record has at least three lenses and a lateral third lens.
No finding is integrated without an explicit user choice.

forbidden_actions: Rewrite the Candidate with findings before disposition.

pass: Findings are classified and the menu keeps seven positions with remaining locks explained.
fail: Findings are merged automatically or the menu is renumbered.

cases.initial_state: Critical review is complete; the canonical recovery record contains accepted decisions, labeled evidence, scope, anti-scope, and an unchanged authority envelope.
cases.expected_output: Preflight exact tracker publication and ready-for-agent label authority, then invoke /mattpocock-to-spec directly with the accepted context. The specialist owns the spec template and tracker publication; no planner or executor is invoked.

assertions.text: The spec producer is the direct next route and receives the accepted context without a new design round.
Authorized paths and actions are passed unchanged.

forbidden_actions: Create a worker brief or parallel recovery record.

pass: The direct spec route is explicit and the producer owns template and tracker work.
fail: The gateway writes a duplicate spec, asks a new design question, or routes directly to planning.

cases.prompt: +spec after the specialist raises a new test boundary
cases.initial_state: Testing Decisions and boundaries were already accepted and passed to /mattpocock-to-spec; the returned work spec introduces a materially new test or specification decision.
cases.expected_output: Do not repeat the accepted interview. Return only the new decision through existing /grill-me eligibility and targeted reevaluation, then recheck the work spec before readiness; add no gate.

assertions.text: Already accepted Testing Decisions and boundaries are passed without a redundant interview.
A material new test or specification decision returns through /grill-me and reevaluation before readiness.

forbidden_actions: Accept the new decision without reevaluation.
Create an extra gate or runtime record.

pass: Only the new material decision is re-routed and the existing route remains the owner.
fail: The gateway repeats the interview, bypasses /grill-me, or invents a new gate.

cases.prompt: Resume the saved analysis and choose +plan.
cases.initial_state: The saved recovery record binds accepted decisions to a returned spec reference. Current source content changed, is unavailable, or cannot be compared with the active unit and decision IDs.
cases.expected_output: Recheck the source and keep plan_authoring_ready false or blocked until the spec is reverified; do not invent identity or hash or create a second recovery record.

assertions.text: Replay or +plan revalidates source coherence against the existing binding.
Changed or unverifiable source does not inherit readiness.

forbidden_actions: Assume the old readiness flag remains valid.
Synthesize a content hash that was not exposed.

pass: The response fails closed on changed or unverifiable source and preserves the single recovery record.
fail: The response promotes a stale or unidentifiable spec.

cases.prompt: +spec from a producer without an exposed version
cases.initial_state: The producer exposes no content identity or version, but its observable returned contents match the active unit and accepted decision IDs.
cases.expected_output: Record the observable-content comparison in the existing recovery record, without inventing identity, hash, or a strong guarantee; readiness may follow only after that comparison passes.

assertions.text: Observable accepted contents are compared with the active unit and accepted decision IDs.
No identity, hash, parallel record, or stronger guarantee is invented.

forbidden_actions: Treat missing identity as an automatic permanent block.

pass: The comparison is recorded and readiness follows only from comparable accepted contents.
fail: The response invents evidence or blocks comparable content solely because no version was exposed.

cases.initial_state: A verified spec is ready and critical review is complete; implementation permission is false.
cases.expected_output: Route to /internal-gateway-writing-plans, which invokes /addyosmani-planning-and-task-breakdown. Do not implement or execute.

assertions.text: The existing writer and planner are the next owners.
The route grants no implementation or execution authority.

pass: Planning is handed off without changing the idea state machine or authority envelope.
fail: The idea gateway writes tasks or starts implementation.
